items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think I first heard you, I was staying with George Lewis one summer for about a month...

ctx.x: And that's where, it was on, um, that was 1943. Yeah. Is that the place on, um, St. Bernard? St. Bernard, yeah. Yeah, the H and J Tavern. The H and J Tavern.

Yeah, that's it. That's the place. Well, I bought this clarinet for my son. So, he got to learn a little bit of horn at these. Learned pretty good, you know. And so he went to California with the horn. And then he came back again. And so, I noticed he wasn't bothering with it. I said, well, George, you know, you're not going to play the clarinet? He said, Dad, I don't care to play the horn. I said, well, no. I said, no. I said, well, I can't let it lay here and go to waste. So, I used to take that horn and my…
Oh, yeah, you got to work in the albert now.

items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: The interviewer mentions talking to Kid Punch about George, and the interviewee responds directly to the interviewer's comment about George, implying personal knowledge and likely interaction, though the specific nature of their professional relationship isn't detailed beyond the clarinet anecdote.

ctx.x: No not that I know of. No. Did it? No. It didn't have a lot of rubber bands. Don's boy used to carry a lot of rubber bands. It was just Ernest Mowier. Oh yeah. Oh boy he died not long ago. Yeah. Well he used to have a lot of rubber bands on his clarinet. I really, every time he'd see it. Of course I used to carry some too myself. Sure that's very handy. I mean that's a good spring when your spring go bad. Yeah it sure is. I used to carry some rubber bands on mine too.

The reason why I said that I asked you that was I was talking to Kid Punch a few months ago. He always used to laugh at George your boy. He said why he had rubber bands on probably every key. I guess that must have been an old clarinet he had.

It might have been the one before that he gave me because I don't remember too many. There was a couple of them or so you know but as far as I can remember. But maybe that might have been one of the old ones you see. Yeah. Just when he bought another one.
